name: Evan D. Schein
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in New York, New York
about: Attorney Evan D. Schein is a partner with Berkman Bottger Newman & Schein LLP law firm, which has law offices in White Plains and New York, New York, as well as Hackensack, New Jersey. A top-ranked trial lawyer with more than 14 years of total legal experience, Mr. Schein leads the firm's litigation practice, and he provides invaluable counsel and support to clients across his region who have legal needs involving any of the following:
· Equitable distribution, property distribution and settlements

As an attorney, Mr. Schein has gained a reputation for his unique ability to develop creative strategies and solutions for his clients in order to help them achieve their goals and the positive results they expect and deserve as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible. He always provides highly personalized counsel to all he serves, and he maintains an unwavering focus on protecting their rights and interests at all turns.

A former sports agent, Mr. Schein has invaluable insight into athlete contracts, endorsement deals and other matters, and he has represented many professional athletes and others with considerable assets during the divorce process. Regardless of his clients' means or status in society, Mr. Schein is fully committed to those he serves, and he has received "Superb" client ratings on Avvo along with numerous testimonials and referrals from those he has served.

In addition, Mr. Schein has earned a Lead Counsel designation as well as many other top rankings and endorsements from his peers, including a Top 10 Under 40 ranking from the National Academy of Family Law Attorneys and a 10 Best Under 40 from the American Institute of Family Law Attorneys. He has also received the Silver Client Champion Award from Martindale-Hubbell as well as a 40 Under 40 designation from the Business Council of Westchester.

A 2003 graduate of Syracuse University, Mr. Schein obtained his Juris Doctor from Syracuse University College of Law in 2006. He is an active member of several local, state and national legal organizations, and he has published numerous articles, blogs and podcasts on a variety of family law topics.
honors: Mr. Schein has been selected as a Rising Star , Super Lawyers Rising Star , 2013-2018
